content: Neural networks outperform the conventional machine learning algorithms in most classification tasks, including sentiment analysis BIBREF0. In these networks, word embedding vectors are fed as input to overcome the data sparsity problem and make the representations of words more “meaningful” and robust. Those embeddings indicate how close the words are to each other in the vector space model (VSM).
